newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot dead in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot dead in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the Pakistani town of Multan on Monday in what his colleagues said was a sectarian murder.
They said two gunmen on a motorcyle shot Qurban Ali Shah, an official of the Tehrik-i-Jafria organisation, on his way to work. His companion, Mohammed Hussain, was wounded.
Armed Sunni and Shi'ite groups are locked in a long-running feud involving gun and grenade attacks on mosques as well as individual killings that cost more than 40 lives in 1996.
